exclusions: Only SecretKit-owned secret APIs are admitted; vendor SDK escape surfaces, key/certificate administration and unexposed endpoints are not callable SecretKit claims.

Management, Event Grid and Log Analytics are public-cloud bounded contracts. Sovereign management endpoints, arbitrary KQL, deprecated server batch, arbitrary Event Grid destinations/settings and private-endpoint provisioning are intentionally out of contract.
Runtime accepts its hashed trusted vault suffixes; endpoint syntax alone does not certify any cloud. Each selected deployment requires its own credentials, rights and complete retained evidence.

CreateOnly and MatchVersion preconditions are explicit local Unsupported outcomes, not fabricated conditional Azure writes. Purge-protection disable and unselected private-connection states are rejected inputs, not supported mutations.
Host credential/transport interfaces and local model/disposal methods are excluded. Both ListVaultsAsync overloads, runtime and management explicit status methods remain admitted.

Primitive value domains are bounded by the hashed types. Variant labels enumerate semantic dimensions rather than every value or Cartesian product; rejection labels require proof of no unauthorized remote effect.
